card.fact_statement: The Rebuilding Korea Party endorsed Lee Jae Myung in the 2025 South Korean presidential election.
card.source_span: Rebuilding Korea Party endorsed Lee Jae Myung of Democratic Party for the presidency.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni mgombea yupi ambaye Chama cha Rebuilding Korea kilimuunga mkono katika uchaguzi wa rais wa Korea Kusini wa 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Rebuilding Korea Party endorsed Lee Jae Myung of Democratic Party for the presidency.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'endorse' as 'kuunga mkono' (to support/endorse) and kept the party name 'Rebuilding Korea' as a proper noun.

backtranslation_en.question: Which candidate did the Rebuilding Korea Party support in the 2025 South Korean presidential election?
